# net

Network chores: public IP and ISP lookup, GitHub keys, URL scraping, media downloads, site mirroring, packet capture, and TLS issuance.

---

## `net_copy_github_keys`

Copy someone's public SSH keys from GitHub to the clipboard, one key per line with their username appended as the comment.

**Usage**

```sh
net_copy_github_keys [github-user]
```

**Examples**

```sh
net_copy_github_keys torvalds
```

**Requires** `curl`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/net.sh:63`](../../modules/common/net.sh#L63)

---

## `net_copy_ssh_pubkey`

Copy your own SSH public key to the clipboard. Prefers ed25519 and falls back to RSA; pass a path to pick a specific key.

**Usage**

```sh
net_copy_ssh_pubkey [path-to-pubkey]
```

**Examples**

```sh
net_copy_ssh_pubkey
net_copy_ssh_pubkey ~/.ssh/work_ed25519.pub
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/net.sh:116`](../../modules/common/net.sh#L116)

## `net_download_audio`

Download audio only and transcode it to mp3.

**Usage**

```sh
net_download_audio <url>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
net_download_audio 'https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ'
```

**Requires** `yt-dlp`, `ffmpeg`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/net.sh:165`](../../modules/common/net.sh#L165)

## `net_download_format`

Download a specific format id, as listed by net_list_formats.

**Usage**


## `net_dump_tcp_headers`

Dump readable ASCII payloads of TCP traffic heading to a port. Defaults to port 80. Needs root, so it will prompt for sudo.

**Usage**

```sh
net_dump_tcp_headers [port]
```

**Examples**

```sh
net_dump_tcp_headers
net_dump_tcp_headers 8080
```

**Requires** `tcpdump`, `sudo`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/net.sh:249`](../../modules/common/net.sh#L249)

## `net_issue_letsencrypt_cert`

Issue a Let's Encrypt certificate using the manual DNS-01 challenge, in a throwaway working directory so nothing lands in /etc.

**Usage**

```sh
net_issue_letsencrypt_cert <domain> [email]
```

**Examples**

```sh
net_issue_letsencrypt_cert example.com admin@example.com
```

**Requires** `certbot`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/net.sh:269`](../../modules/common/net.sh#L269)

## `net_normalize_ip`

Turn a mangled IP such as AWS's `ip-10-0-3-17` or `10_0_3_17` back into a real dotted-quad, print it, and put it on the clipboard.

**Usage**

```sh
net_normalize_ip <mangled-ip>
```

**Examples**

```sh
net_normalize_ip ip-10-0-3-17
net_normalize_ip 192_168_1_10
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/net.sh:100`](../../modules/common/net.sh#L100)
